about: What the creator gave a place's concept draw beyond its look (data/definitions/place.json), its floor plan's description (`for` in data/definitions/<shell>_floor.json, read for every place a floor plan names) and where it sits (within.json), read the same way for every place by score/review/concepts.py (CONTEXT.md "concept"): `says`, his words sent as they are (a measure he set stays: the ship's 46 m, data/definitions/ship_floor.json's length); `references`, his pictures sent for look only, each with what it `shows`, only with the place it shows (the owner, 2026-10-21: the cockpit's and the quarters' own; the other rooms take their look from the crop of the hangar's picked concept and the style) (`{home}`: the prop tools' home, whose references/ is the private bucket's references/ copied here, never this public repository); `people` (optional), whether its draw shows people, over its cast record. What a place sits in comes from no setting here: its draw is sent a crop of the layer above's picked concept to the inventory row its plan says holds it (score/review/concepts.py holding_box).

hangar.says: It holds the ship, a crew shuttle 46 m long, at its true size.

references.shows: the ship's look only (a much smaller ship)
